## Goal
`tools/layoutgen` turns `layouts/<name>/layout.yaml` into every artefact of design §6.1 (v1 subset), and the
generated files for `standard` are committed.

## Owned files
- tools/layoutgen/**
- layouts/standard/generated/**

## Lead tests (do not edit)
- tools/layoutgen/tests/test_layoutgen.py

## Forbidden
- AGENTS.md §4; no RMF dependencies; do not edit `layouts/schema/`, `layouts/standard/layout.yaml` or fixtures.
- Only stdlib + PyYAML + jsonschema (present in the dev image). Write the PGM by hand (no Pillow/numpy).

## Commands to run
```bash
export MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 PATH="/c/Program Files/Docker/Docker/resources/bin:$PATH"
export COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=swarmflow-<your-worktree-dir-name>
docker compose run --rm -T dev python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tools/layoutgen
docker compose run --rm -T dev python3 tools/layoutgen/generate.py layouts/standard/layout.yaml --out layouts/standard/generated
```

## Specification
- CLI `tools/layoutgen/generate.py <layout.yaml> --out <dir>`; code in a package `tools/layoutgen/layoutgen/`
  plus `tools/layoutgen/pyproject.toml` (name `swarmflow-layoutgen`). Exit 1 with a clear message naming the
  offending field/vertex on any error. Validate against `layouts/schema/layout.schema.json` (jsonschema) **and**
  semantic checks: unique vertex names; lanes/zones/spawn reference existing vertices; zone lanes exist; every lane
  entering a zone vertex from outside the zone starts at that entry's hold (design §6.3 item 2); holds outside the
  zone polygons.
- `nav_graph.yaml` + `zones.yaml`: must equal `tests/fixtures/standard/*` after YAML load. The reference algorithm
  is `tests/fixtures/make_fixtures.py` — read it and reuse its rules (rounding to 3 decimals, vertex order, lane
  order, payload geometry, `feasible` = clear ≥ padded_y + 0.10, `two_way_ok` = clear ≥ 2·padded_y + 0.30).
  Header comment: `# GENERATED by tools/layoutgen — do not edit.`
- `map.pgm` (P5, maxval 255, free 254, occupied 0) + `map.yaml` (`image: map.pgm`, resolution from the layout,
  origin `[x_min − 0.5, y_min − 0.5, 0.0]`, size = bounds + 0.5 m margin each side, `negate: 0`,
  `occupied_thresh: 0.65`, `free_thresh: 0.25`, `mode: trinary`). Occupied: racks, walls (`wall_thickness_m`
  outside the bounds) and everything outside the walls. A cell is occupied if its centre lies in an obstacle.
- `world.sdf` (SDF 1.9, `<world name="<layout name>">`), everything inline (no `<include>` / Fuel):
  plugins `gz-sim-physics-system` (`gz::sim::systems::Physics`), `gz-sim-user-commands-system`
  (`gz::sim::systems::UserCommands`), `gz-sim-scene-broadcaster-system` (`gz::sim::systems::SceneBroadcaster`),
  `gz-sim-sensors-system` (`gz::sim::systems::Sensors`) with `<render_engine>ogre2</render_engine>`;
  `<physics>` with `max_step_size 0.004`, `real_time_factor 1.0`; a directional `sun` light; `ground_plane`
  (static, plane collision + visual, 100 × 100 m); 4 static `wall_*` boxes (`wall_height_m`, `wall_thickness_m`,
  outside the bounds); static `rack_<name>` boxes (collision + visual, full height, model pose at the box centre);
  visual-only flat pads `station_<name>` (0.8 × 0.8 × 0.01 m; loading green, delivery blue, park grey); package pool
  `pkg_00..pkg_11`: non-static model, one link with `<gravity>false</gravity>`, a 0.40 × 0.40 × 0.30 m box
  **visual only** (no collision), brown, parked outside the building at `x = x_min − 3.0`, `y = y_min + 0.6·i`,
  `z = 0.15`.
- `sim2d.json`: `{name, bounds, racks, vertices: {name: {x, y, kind}}, edges: [{from, to, length_m, zone}],
  zones: [{name, polygon, entries}], spawn}` — sorted, deterministic, `indent=2`.
- v2 keepout masks are out of scope (do not create `keepout/`).
- Output must be byte-identical across runs (fixed float formatting, sorted keys/lists).
- Commit the generated `layouts/standard/generated/` (CI regenerates it and fails on any diff).

## Definition of done
- `tools/layoutgen/tests/test_layoutgen.py` passes unchanged; add tests for anything else you rely on.
- Generated files committed; regenerating gives no diff. Commit "T006: layout generator", card status `review`.

## Inputs / contracts used
- docs/design.md §6.1, §7.2; layouts/schema/*; layouts/standard/layout.yaml; tests/fixtures/make_fixtures.py
